observed_failure.diagnosis: UART line100 records IRQ3 vector51 at IRQL24. Lines111-112 record checks10-11. Lines114-115 record the owned eventobj.c:168 assertion, followed by BUGCHECK1E at line120. The old probe calls KeSetEvent directly from its ISR; the direct public export asserts IRQL<=DISPATCH_LEVEL.

reviewed_boundaries: main.c:20,37-45,92-93: static owned KDPC/event storage and NTAPI four-argument deferred routine are initialized before interrupt connection. DeferredContext is the exact initialized event address.

main.c:48-58: ISR retains acknowledgement, original public object/context capture and callback count, replacing direct event signaling with KeInsertQueueDpc. A false insert result can mean the same DPC is already queued and does not itself establish failed delivery.

main.c:43-45,140-142: DPC records its IRQL/count before signaling; the existing liveness check now requires a successful bounded wait, ISR delivery, DPC delivery and DISPATCH_LEVEL. The two-second timeout and all17 public object/guard/lifecycle checks are retained.

main.c:131-136: hardware vblank is masked, pending vblank acknowledged, owned interrupt disconnected, and queued notification removed before PCRTC enable restoration. No static callback storage is freed or reused. On the target uniprocessor, passive main cannot overlap an executing DISPATCH DPC; disconnect stops future ISR queueing on success.

ntoskrnl/xb/ordinals.map:155,167,185,193: public DPC initialize/queue/remove and event signal map directly to owned kernel bodies. sdk/include/xdk/ketypes.h:751-764 matches the public28-byte KDPC layout.
